meta.footEn: Data snapshot: 2026-08-25 · Garmin fenix 8 via Freddy

en.c4d: -9 vs last recorded night (50) · -1 vs 7-night avg (42)
en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.rec: The bedtime advice landed. Friday's board asked for lights-out nearer 23:00; last night — Monday evening into this Tuesday morning — it went out at 22:20, the earliest of the seven, and the result was 8h 00m asleep. That is the longest night on the board, 27 minutes clear of the next best (7h 33m) and a full 1h 04m above the 6h 56m seven-night average. Garmin grades total duration excellent for the first time in the window. The score is 80, and the gap between that and Friday's 89 is entirely about depth rather than length. Deep sleep came in at just 50 minutes, 10% of the night — the shallowest reading of the window apart from the two short nights a week ago, and 69 minutes down on Friday's 119. REM was the compensation at 108 minutes, 22% of the night and the second-highest of the seven. Six brief wake episodes added up to 28 minutes, so efficiency was 94% against Friday's 99%. Garmin's component grades tell the same story: duration and REM excellent, everything else — deep, light, awake count, restlessness, stress — fair. The autonomic picture is steady rather than spectacular. HRV read 41, nine below Friday's 50 but within a point of the 42 average, so this is a return to baseline, not a dip below it. RHR was 54, four above Friday's 50 and one above the 53 average — but it is three below the 57 posted on both Sunday and Monday, the two training days, which is the direction you want two days after a hard squat session. Overnight stress read 18, the second-lowest of the window. Body Battery charged 52 points. Readiness lands at 76, good. Two housekeeping notes. First, the nights of Saturday 22 and Sunday 23 have no sleep record at all — the watch was not worn, which is why the dashboard sat unrefreshed until this morning; the chart therefore jumps from Friday evening to Monday evening. Second, keep the 22:20 bedtime. It bought an hour of sleep at no cost and it is the single change that has moved duration out of the fair band. The thing to chase now is depth, not length: 50 minutes of deep is the one number here worth improving, and it usually responds to a consistent bedtime held for several nights in a row rather than to any single early night.

hr.c3d: +4 vs zadnja zabilježena noć (50) · +1 vs prosjek 7 noći (53)
hr.c4d: -9 vs zadnja zabilježena noć (50) · -1 vs prosjek 7 noći (42)
hr.c5d: izračunato iz sna, HRV-a, RHR-a, stresa i opterećenja
hr.rec: Savjet o vremenu lijeganja je upalio. Petkova ploča tražila je gašenje svjetla bliže 23:00; sinoć — večer ponedjeljka do jutros u utorak — svjetlo se ugasilo u 22:20, najranije od sedam noći, a rezultat je 8h 00m sna. To je najdulja noć na ploči, 27 minuta iznad sljedeće najbolje (7h 33m) i punih 1h 04m iznad sedmodnevnog prosjeka od 6h 56m. Garmin je ukupno trajanje prvi put u ovom prozoru ocijenio izvrsnim. Ocjena je 80, a razlika prema petkovih 89 u cijelosti je stvar dubine, a ne duljine. Duboki san iznosio je svega 50 minuta, 10% noći — najplići rezultat u prozoru uz iznimku dvije kratke noći od prije tjedan dana, i 69 minuta manje od petkovih 119. REM je bio kompenzacija sa 108 minuta, 22% noći i drugi najviši od sedam. Šest kratkih buđenja zbrojilo se na 28 minuta, pa je učinkovitost 94% naspram petkovih 99%. Garminove ocjene sastavnica govore isto: trajanje i REM izvrsni, sve ostalo — duboki, laki, broj buđenja, nemir, stres — osrednje. Autonomna slika je stabilna, a ne blistava. HRV je iznosio 41, devet ispod petkovih 50 ali unutar jednog boda od prosjeka 42, pa je ovo povratak na osnovicu, a ne pad ispod nje. RHR je bio 54, četiri iznad petkovih 50 i jedan iznad prosjeka od 53 — ali tri ispod 57 koliko je zabilježeno i u nedjelju i u ponedjeljak, dva dana treninga, što je smjer koji želiš dva dana nakon teškog čučnja. Noćni stres iznosio je 18, drugi najniži u prozoru. Body Battery napunio se 52 boda. Spremnost je 76, dobra. Dvije napomene. Prvo, noći subote 22. i nedjelje 23. nemaju nikakav zapis sna — sat nije bio nošen, zbog čega je ploča ostala neosvježena sve do jutros; graf zato preskače s petkove večeri na ponedjeljkovu. Drugo, zadrži lijeganje u 22:20. Donijelo je sat vremena sna bez ikakve cijene i jedina je promjena koja je trajanje izvukla iz osrednjeg razreda. Ono što sada treba loviti je dubina, ne duljina: 50 minuta dubokog sna jedini je broj ovdje vrijedan popravka, a on obično reagira na dosljedno vrijeme lijeganja održano nekoliko noći zaredom, a ne na jednu ranu noć.
